note: Trigger-routing suite, converted from the pre-migration corpus's scripts/routing-corpus.json (positives/negatives) into forge's cases schema. Checked-in routing corpus (test of record). Positives = md-sys size/space consumption queries INCLUDING a control's own text-size ('what font size for this button' — geometry owns it via --md-sys-size-{step}-font). Negatives: color, the type SCALE of non-control text, the --size-* twin.
